name: blender_apply
description: Change the attached Blender document with up to 50 operations, applied atomically as one undo step named 'OpenCode: <summary>'. Needs the script_handle and the exact revision from blender_context, and a new command_id (replaying a command_id applies nothing). expect clauses are checked before anything runs. On failure the document is restored. Mutations run in Object mode only. Operations with side effects (render, downloads, file writes) must be alone in their apply and cannot be undone.

if_revision.description: The revision the operations are based on.

command_id.description: A new unique ID for this change (letters, digits, . _ : -).

summary.description: Short name of the undo step.
